messages:
michael: heads-up: multiple customers reported 429s when hitting the gptx-large endpoints during spikes. quota-bot flagged per-key limit hit, but only for that model family. Not happening on smaller families. Thoughts on model-specific quotas?
sara: we've always had per-family quotas in the DB but enforcement is currently only at org-level. Are the 429s from per-key or per-org limit? quota-bot shows per-key burst exhausted.
quota-bot: ALERT: key=k_abc123 exceeded burst_tokens for family=gptx-large between 2026-01-25T02:34Z - returning 429.
jiwoo: Is the idea to make default limits proportional to model size / token-rate? e.g., large models = fewer concurrent tokens/sec.
luis: yeah. Proposal: base_limit_per_key = 60 reqs/min. For families, apply multiplier = 1/(model_flops_index). Simpler: tiny=2.0, small=1.5, base=1.0, large=0.6, xlarge=0.3. Also add short burst bucket + smoothing window.
ana: (typo) ana: important: Dedicated customers who have reserved capacity must bypass family caps if they've paid for that throughput.
michael: Agree. Also need console UX: show per-model-family usage + projected SLO risk. Right now console only shows aggregate.
sara: telemetry: add timeseries for rate_limiter.blocked_by tag (values: org, key, family, capacity). We'll need per-route breakdown too.
jiwoo: Implementation detail: rate-limiter currently keys on (org, key). We can include family in token bucket key but that increases counters. Storage/memory impact?
luis: We can keep token buckets per (org, key, family) but only when family is non-default; lazy-create buckets. Eviction TTL 15m.
michael: Also discuss API: do we surface quota headers like X-Quota-Remaining-Family and X-Quota-Burst-Window?
sara: Yes. Minimal headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-RateLimit-Family-Remaining. Add telemetry flag to opt-out for PII concerns.
ana: ana: Edge-case: customers doing multi-model routing (fallback chain). Need a policy: decrement both chosen-family and requested-family buckets? Probably only actual executed model.
jiwoo: I think decrement only executed. But routing could require reserving tokens across candidates to avoid thundering herd when fallback fails.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling out rate-limiter change to canary cluster tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
michael: Action items: 1) agree family multiplier buckets (sara + luis), 2) console mockups (michael + ana), 3) telemetry tags + headers (jiwoo), 4) canary + observability playbook (ops). I'll create tickets.
sara: I'll sketch multiplier table and drop a PR: tiny=2.0, small=1.5, base=1.0, large=0.6, xlarge=0.3.
luis: We should also allow per-org overrides via console -> org-settings -> quotas -> family-overrides.
jiwoo: Spikes: implement short-burst tokens = 10 tokens, refill per 5s, smoothing window 60s.
michael: :thumbsup: ok. Let's meet 10am PT to finalize. @ops-bot can you schedule canary window and alert thresholds?
ops-bot: scheduled: canary window 2026-02-02T03:00Z-04:00Z. Pager thresholds: >1% 429s for >5m.
quota-bot: INFO: Created ticket Q-4321 'family-aware rate limiter' assigned to eng-platform.
notes: thread about model-specific quotas, burst controls, console/telemetry changes
